## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes / passe
- [ ] Plugin touched? `claude plugin test plugin/agent-room` and `claude plugin validate .` pass, and `version` is bumped in `plugin/agent-room/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
- [ ] New text? Added in **both** languages (`public/i18n.js` or `bin/i18n.js`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] No secret, token or private path in the diff / Aucun secret ni chemin privé dans le diff
